name: Sour pho
summary: Phở chua is Cao Bang’s sour noodle bowl, not a hot beef pho: rice noodles under roast duck, crisp pork belly, and smoked sausage, dressed in a vinegar sauce thickened with canna starch and seasoned with sugar, garlic, and chili. The sauce is mildly sour and lightly sweet, and fried sweet-potato threads, crushed roasted peanut, cucumber, and herbs go on last.
howToEat: Some bowls take a little duck broth before the sauce and some come with only the sweet-sour dressing. Eat it in town at breakfast or midday, and know that morning service in Thục Phán ward is limited.
where: Cao Bang city, at breakfast or midday. Morning service in Thục Phán ward is limited.
seoTitle: Sour pho in Cao Bang — not a hot beef bowl
seoDescription: Phở chua is Cao Bang’s sour noodle bowl, not a hot beef pho.
taste: Báo Cao Bằng on 21 May 2026 calls the sauce mildly sour and lightly sweet, and names the crisp potato, the fatty meat, the nutty peanut, and the herbs.
